verdict: Yes. Pad Care pitched menstrual hygiene disposal units on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from four sharks. Offices, schools and malls must handle sanitary waste safely, and a service model with regular collection creates recurring revenue.
angle: Most sanitary waste still goes into ordinary bins. Offices and institutions want hygienic disposal and recycling. A subscription service with bins and regular collection works well with corporates, schools and hospitals.
